name: flickering-grid

frames.best_why: The square field is densest and brightest here, so the whole texture reads at once.

tagline: Small pale squares blink brighter and dimmer at random.
summary: A canvas backdrop of small squares scattered on black where each square changes its opacity at random, so the field flickers like distant static.
appearance: A black stage filled with a loose grid of small pale squares at varying opacity, densest near the middle and fading toward the edges. A rounded dark card with a heading and caption sits in the centre.
behaviour: Squares randomly switch their opacity many times a second, so patches of the grid blink brighter and dimmer while the overall field holds its place.
demo_content: The centre card reads "Flickering Grid" over the line "Canvas squares that fade in and out at random."
use_when: A dark section wants a living, faintly digital texture behind a short message.
avoid_when: Dense text: the constant random blinking is distracting beside small type.
customise: Square size, gap, flicker chance, colour, max opacity and explicit width or height are props; the fade mask comes from a class.
weight_why: A requestAnimationFrame loop redraws thousands of canvas squares every frame.

a11y.note: The canvas is decorative with no text alternative, and the constant flicker ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: The flicker has no reduced-motion handling and can bother photosensitive users.
polish_why: Even field and believable flicker, but it is a generic effect and the caption is faint.
title: Flickering Grid
